input.brief: Bengkel radiator: kasir servis, pelanggan dan unit kendaraan, stok sparepart, laporan harian

style.name: Achromatic ledger
style.basis: 4 screens: a seller home, a per-agent insights page, a generated report, a settings page with usage numbers
style.idea: The chrome holds no colour at all; money and counts are set in ink, the one chart hue marks the screen's main data element, and the only other hue is a small signal where a figure changed.
style.colourBudget: under 1% coloured pixels; the chrome is ink, the one chart hue goes on the main data element, and the only other hue is a small change signal

font.second: Geist Mono, for IDs and keys only
font.note: 700 is for money figures only; every other number is 400-500.

style.signature: No brand colour anywhere in the chrome: the one primary action is near-black (a grey pill, #e5e5e5, is the secondary), the main data element (today's series, the booked bars, the current period) takes the one chart hue, #1d5fbf, and everything else is drawn in ink with the comparison or the part after the cursor in grey, zero balances are set in grey, and the only hue on the screen is a small triangle or a short coloured number where a figure changed.
identity: A ground from the product's world in place of #f8f8f8, one level off white and low in chroma: a stone (#f4f3f1) for a bakery or a shop, a sage (#f2f5f2) for a garden or a greenhouse, a blue-grey (#f2f4f7) for a ledger or a meter. Cards stay white; a warm tint stays under the cream check (saturation under about 15%).

The one chart hue (#1d5fbf, or the brand's own hue at 3:1 or more on white) on the screen's main data element: today's line, the booked bars, the current period's column, the margin that breaks. The chrome stays ink and the hue stays under 1% of the screen.
Every figure in Geist Mono, as the style's decision, so money and counts read as a ledger's columns while the text stays Geist. Lint and the inspector flag mono; give the reason in the report.
avoid: tinted cards or tinted KPI tiles
a coloured chart where one series in ink says it
a chart with no y-scale (the study's one example of this look hid magnitude behind hover and was flagged)
a grey pill as the only button for the screen's main job: in testing an Approve repeated in grey on every row left the screen without a primary
style.notes: The studied screens of this kind used 11-12px card radii, which §9.4 counts among the rare middle values; the library sets the tight pair (8 and 6) so the style lands on the bimodal rule. After testing, the chart hue moved from an unused third series colour onto the main data element: a screen whose only hue was a delta read as a kit.

shell.name: Icon rail

numbers.active: icon colour alone, or a full-bleed 50px band at a 2% tint, or a 1px accent bar on the rail's border
numbers.utilities: pushed to the bottom after a gap of about 200px

shell.blueprint: An unlabelled rail of 50-60px carries the brand mark at the top and 15-18px outline icons on a 34-49px pitch; groups are split by 20px hairlines, utilities sit at the bottom. The rail sits on the page ground with a 1px edge, or is white with a faint 4px shadow on a grey ground. It saves about 180px of width against a labelled sidebar, so it suits products with few destinations and screens that need the width. Icons need tooltips and an accessible name.
shell.phone: The rail becomes a bottom bar with the same four or five icons, each with a short label under it.

pattern.name: KPIs as the chart's tabs
pattern.blueprint: One card per subject, 8-16px apart: the main chart card runs full width, and any card holding a table of five columns or fewer, or a short list, pairs with its neighbour in two columns, the page header indented by the card padding so the title, the card titles, the numbers and the plot share one left edge. Balances that do not change during the day go first, in one container split by 1px dividers into equal columns; a zero balance is grey and its caption becomes the next step. In the main card, 2-4 KPIs sit in a row and act as the chart's series tabs: the selected one carries a 2px rule and an ink label, the others keep a grey label and their value in ink at a lighter weight (a grey value reads as disabled); when the tabs are the per-entity breakdown the brief asks for (takings by shop), nothing is greyed and the rule alone marks the selection. Choosing one swaps the series. Under them, one line chart as wide as the card's content (about 1136x220 in the study): 3-4 solid 1px gridlines, 4-6 round y ticks at 12px, a 2-3px line in ink with straight segments and no fill, an 8px hover dot with a 1px dashed guide and the line after the cursor in pale grey. Close with a 2-3 row comparison table on a 36px pitch, value and change columns right-aligned under a 14px grey header such as 'vs prior Monday'.
pattern.phone: KPI tabs become a 2-up grid above the chart, with the selected cell marked by a fill (never an underline floating inside the grid) or a row of tabs that scrolls sideways; the chart is full width, 160-200px tall, with 4 x labels; the comparison table keeps its two right-aligned columns.

pattern.name: Table with tabs and a filter bar
pattern.basis: an events back office, a tracks studio, a sessions overview
pattern.blueprint: Title row: an 18-24px title on the left, at most an outlined secondary and the one primary (36px) on the right. Underline tabs for the list's states on a full-width 1px rule with a 2px indicator as wide as the label; 22-32px below, the toolbar: a search of about 252-316 x 32-36 on the left, the count ('7 events') and the sort on the right. The table sits on the panel or page ground with no card around it: a header of 12-13px grey sentence-case labels with no fill and no rule, rows on a 48-56px pitch for one line or 72-92px with a thumbnail (media height plus 24-32px), 1px rules 3-7% darker than the ground or no rules at all, the identity column given the most width, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures with the unit muted ('5 /10'), one status mark per row and one kebab at the far right. Drop a column that is empty in every row (a blank co-host column left a 300px dead band). On an overview, cap the rows and link to the full list; on the full list, state the total and load more at the end.
pattern.phone: Rows become two-line items: identity and the key number on line 1, the secondary fields in 13px grey on line 2, the kebab at the right. Tabs scroll in their own row; the search becomes a full-width field.

pattern.name: Object header and a six-column grid
pattern.blueprint: The page header is the object itself: one card (88px, 14px padding) holding a 50x62 cover, the 18/600 name with 28px icon buttons beside it (open, copy, share), a 13px grey meta line (date, time, place) and outlined 36px actions on the right. Under it, underline tabs on a full-width 1px rule, then a 36px row with a segmented time range on the left and a refresh button on the right. The body is one 6-column grid with one gutter (14px) in both directions whose spans change by row while every edge lands on the same lines: 3 KPI tiles of 2 columns, the main chart in 4 columns beside a side chart in 2, two progress cards of 3, a full-width trend of 6. Give the widest card to the screen's question, and do not give 824px to one ring and one legend row (flagged).
pattern.phone: The header card keeps cover, name and meta, with actions in a kebab; every grid item takes the full width in the same order.

pattern.name: Settings in two columns
pattern.basis: one settings page; stacking from a narrow rail card. The basis is thin.
pattern.blueprint: A centred column of about 1152px. Each section is one row: a label column of about 450px (16/500 title, 14px grey description; the title's cap top 6-8px below the panel top, level with the panel's first line) beside a panel of about 700px with a #fafafa fill, 16px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow. Sections are split by a full-width 1px rule with 32px above and below. Inside a panel: field labels 14/500 above 40px white inputs (1px #e8e8e8, radius 10), 8px from label to field, 16px between fields, 24px from the description to the first label, 16px to the Save button; switch rows with a 14/500 title, a 20px status badge 8px after it, a 14px grey description and a 28x16 toggle 16px from the right edge, centred on the title line. A plan-gated feature shows a 48px tinted strip with a 32px button directly above its panel, and the panel stays readable. When a panel runs much taller than its label, put the section's help or a summary of the current values in the label column rather than 250px of nothing.
pattern.phone: Each section stacks: title and description, then the panel at full width. Inside, label, 8-10px, field, 16-26px to the next pair; toggles stay on the right of their title.
